body:
BlackRock has opened the BlackRock HKD Digital Liquidity Fund, its first tokenized money market fund in Hong Kong, to retail and institutional investors, the asset manager said in a statement on Tuesday, Nov. 24, The Block reported [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). The fund had $100 million under management as of Nov. 20 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

The fund has an accumulating class, whose net asset value can change, and a distributing class that seeks a constant unit price and pays out income [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). BlackRock says it is the first Hong Kong-domiciled money market fund to offer a constant NAV to both institutional and retail investors locally [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). Holdings are valued at amortized cost with a separate daily mark-to-market NAV, and the fund may switch to market pricing if the gap reaches 50 basis points [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

"Investors want cash solutions that are simple, trusted and available when they need them," said Dan Maley, head of APAC digital assets at BlackRock [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission authorized the fund in September, when BlackRock named Standard Chartered as custodian, fund administrator, trustee and tokenization partner [[2]](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/blackrock-approved-for-first-tokenized-fund-in-hong-kong-including-retail/). It adds a Hong Kong dollar fund to BlackRock's tokenized money market range in US dollars, euros and sterling, which includes the BUIDL fund tokenized by Securitize in the US [[2]](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/blackrock-approved-for-first-tokenized-fund-in-hong-kong-including-retail/). BlackRock did not disclose the blockchain or minimum investment amounts in the materials reviewed [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524)[[3]](https://www.blackrock.com/hk/en/investment-ideas/hkd-digital-liquidity-fund). Banks are pushing tokenized cash elsewhere too: JPMorgan's Kinexys and DBS this month started round-the-clock transfers between their tokenized deposit platforms, and the ECB will accept some tokenized assets as collateral from June 2027.

p: BlackRock이 홍콩 최초의 토큰화 머니마켓펀드인 BlackRock HKD Digital Liquidity Fund를 개인투자자와 기관투자자에게 개방했다고 이 운용사가 11월 24일(화) 성명에서 밝혔다고 The Block이 보도했다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). 이 펀드의 운용자산은 11월 20일 기준 1억 달러다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

이 펀드는 순자산가치(NAV)가 변동할 수 있는 누적형(accumulating) 클래스와, 일정한 단위 가격을 추구하며 수익을 분배하는 분배형(distributing) 클래스로 구성된다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). BlackRock은 이 펀드가 홍콩 현지의 기관투자자와 개인투자자 모두에게 고정 NAV를 제공하는 최초의 홍콩 설정 머니마켓펀드라고 밝혔다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524). 보유 자산은 상각원가로 평가하되 별도로 일별 시가평가 NAV를 산출하며, 두 값의 차이가 50bp에 이르면 시장가 평가로 전환할 수 있다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

BlackRock의 APAC 디지털자산 총괄 Dan Maley는 "투자자들은 단순하고 신뢰할 수 있으며 필요할 때 바로 이용할 수 있는 현금 솔루션을 원한다"고 말했다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524).

홍콩 증권선물위원회(SFC)는 지난 9월 이 펀드를 인가했으며, 당시 BlackRock은 Standard Chartered를 수탁기관, 펀드 사무관리회사, 신탁회사이자 토큰화 파트너로 선정했다 [[2]](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/blackrock-approved-for-first-tokenized-fund-in-hong-kong-including-retail/). 이번 펀드는 미국에서 Securitize가 토큰화한 BUIDL 펀드를 포함해 달러, 유로, 파운드로 구성된 BlackRock의 토큰화 머니마켓펀드 라인업에 홍콩달러 펀드를 추가하는 것이다 [[2]](https://www.ledgerinsights.com/blackrock-approved-for-first-tokenized-fund-in-hong-kong-including-retail/). BlackRock은 검토 대상 자료에서 사용 블록체인과 최소 투자금액을 공개하지 않았다 [[1]](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-24-blackrock-opens-tokenized-money-market-fund-with-100-million-in-assets-to-hong-kong-investors-445524)[[3]](https://www.blackrock.com/hk/en/investment-ideas/hkd-digital-liquidity-fund). 다른 지역에서도 은행들이 토큰화 현금 확산에 나서고 있다. JPMorgan의 Kinexys와 DBS는 이달 각자의 토큰화 예금 플랫폼 간 24시간 이체를 시작했고, ECB는 2027년 6월부터 일부 토큰화 자산을 담보로 받아들일 예정이다.
